ios.desc:
Wunderbrain streamlines brain training by targeting cognitive fundamentals through games based on neuroscience. This allows you to train your brain in minutes.
Wunderbrain has a sleek design and is available for free.

• 15 fundamental brain-training games scientifically designed to develop cognitive skills: attention, memory, speed, accuracy, flexibility, inhibition, perception.
• Guidelines for brain health and performance.
• Exercise suggestion ("Game of the Day" and random game).
• Works offline. No sign-up required.

More and more people use Wunderbrain: students, athletes, business people, seniors, etc.

Brain training is based on neuroplasticity, the ability of the brain to adapt.
Brain fitness translates to better performance in intellectual and physical activities.

We regularly release free Wunderbrain updates. We would like to know how we can improve Wunderbrain. Please get in touch with us via the App Store “Support” link.
